name: Silva Villas Phuket
shortDescription: Small off-plan collection of four 3-bedroom villas of 290-350 sqm in Si Sunthon, Thalang, about 6 km from Bang Tao Beach.
description:
Silva (listed on FazWaz as Silva Phuket) is a small collection of four three-bedroom villas in Si Sunthon, Thalang, in the quieter inland area behind Bang Tao. Each villa has four bathrooms and about 290 to 350 sqm of built-up space. A sales agent states each home has a private pool; we have not seen the developer's own plans to confirm this.
Completion is scheduled for September 2027 and the project is off-plan. Garden space, parking, 24-hour security and CCTV are listed, pets are allowed, and listed common-area fees are THB 25 per sqm per month with a sinking fund of THB 500 per sqm.
Si Sunthon puts Porto de Phuket and Villa Market Laguna about 3.8 km away and Bang Tao Beach about 6 km away (straight line); the airport is about 18.8 km. Do not confuse it with Silva Residences, a separate four-villa project in Cherng Talay. Listed asking prices run from THB 22.5 million to 25 million.
